queries: WITH race_avg AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_wins FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_wins) AS avg_wins FROM race_avg GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM country_avg), above AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, o.overall_avg FROM country_avg ca CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.overall_avg), grp AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS group_avg FROM above) SELECT a.country, a.avg_wins, a.avg_wins - a.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, a.avg_wins - g.group_avg AS above_group_avg FROM above a CROSS JOIN grp g WHERE a.avg_wins > g.group_avg ORDER BY a.avg_wins DESC

assumptions.assumption: The 'wins' figure is driverStandings.wins used as stored (a season-to-date running count). Each race's figure is the plain average of that value across all drivers listed in that race's standings.

The 'average across countries' is the unweighted mean of the per-country averages, with each country counting once. The 'group average' is the unweighted mean of the above-average countries' averages.
Races with no standings rows are left out, because there is nothing to average for them.

assumptions.assumption: Per race, the average is taken over all drivers listed in driverStandings for that race, using the running season-to-date wins value at that race (including drivers with 0 wins).

The 'average across countries' is the unweighted mean of the country averages, so each country counts once regardless of how many races it hosted. The 'group average' is likewise the unweighted mean of the above-average countries' averages.
Races with no driverStandings rows are excluded because they have no standings to average.

assumptions.assumption: driverStandings.wins is used as stored (season-to-date running count) and averaged over all drivers with a standings row at each race, as the request literally says; it is not converted to wins in that single race.
The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-country averages (each country counts once), and the group average is the unweighted mean of the above-average countries' averages.
